steps.en: Install the SDK; the engine and weights are fetched once
steps.zh: 装好 SDK，引擎与权重首次使用时拉取一次

steps.en: Declare the tools your app exposes
steps.zh: 声明你的 App 要暴露的工具

steps.en: Fetches your platform's sub-1 MB engine and loads the 2-bit weights
steps.zh: 取回你所在平台的亚 1 MB 引擎，加载 2-bit 权重

steps.en: Compiles your schemas into a byte-level grammar that constrains every token
steps.zh: 把你的 schema 编成逐 token 约束的 grammar

steps.en: Sends the sentence to the model and returns calls, reasoning and a confidence score
steps.zh: 把英文送给模型，返回调用、reasoning 与 confidence

steps.en: Calls your Python functions with those arguments and feeds the results back
steps.zh: 用这些参数调用你的 Python 函数，并把结果回喂

steps.en: Read results, and treat empty function_calls as a refusal
steps.zh: 读 results，把空的 function_calls 当作拒绝

value.en: One English sentence becomes a schema-valid tool call executed on-device, with no prompt-and-parse plumbing and no network call
value.zh: 一句英文在设备本地变成可执行、符合 schema 的工具调用，不用自己拼 prompt 和解析器，也不走网络

sources: README.md: Get started (pip install, @needle.tool, agent.run), Deploy (needle build --platform)
needle/__init__.py: Needle.complete / Needle.run loop and the JSON envelope fields
needle/agent/tools.py: build_schema compiles decorated functions into the tool schema
needle/agent/fetch.py: PLATFORMS, engine and .cact weight fetch from Hugging Face
llms.txt: Core API, Response shape, Behaviour contract
